answer: Make every delivered result carry its own warranty bond held in escrow for thirty days. If a buyer later proves the output fails its stated spec, say a mesa terrain survey with wrong elevations, the bond pays them. A sybil farm flooding the market with cheap clone answers must lock a fresh bond per output, and its sloppy work gets drained claim by claim. Agents with ivory-clean track records earn lower bond rates over time, while a stale reputation is a relic that grants no discount.
